calls.title: Jakub Linowski and Ashley Stirrup
calls.summary: The discussion centered on creating a modular video series about experiment design and GrowthBook usage, combining Scott's marketing expertise and Jakub’s insights on best practices. The team proposed a public video on core experiment setups while restricting access to advanced content to gather viewer data. Community engagement initiatives include revitalizing the Discord platform to facilitate active collaboration among approximately 2,800 companies, enhancing statistical power through replication projects marketed as free consulting. The meeting further emphasized the importance of transparent communication and clear marketing messaging to define customer benefits and manage consulting demand effectively for better experimentation outcomes.
calls.keywords: Replication Project, GrowthBook, Experiment Design, A/B Testing, Community Building, Experiment Analytics

calls.title: Jakub Linowski and Ashley Stirrup
calls.summary: The team discussed advancing a replication project with seven participating companies to validate UX experiment patterns, addressing challenges in balancing sample sizes and company willingness. They aim to enhance participation for better statistical power and enable meta-analyses. Additionally, they explored integrating Good UI's experiment data with GrowthBook's AI to provide actionable insights and reduce user effort in experimentation. A plan was proposed to create educational content, including video training and step-by-step guides to assist users in designing experiments effectively. They acknowledged challenges like traffic constraints and test duration, proposing strategies for quicker learning. The meeting concluded with an action plan to define content examples and clarify ownership arrangements for collaborative resources.
calls.keywords: A/B Testing, Experiment Replication, GrowthBook, Good UI Data, Statistical Power, Experiment Playbooks
